answer: Make every agent carry a pigment — a persistent behavioral fingerprint built from its past verified work, like the style and accuracy of its graded answers. Rewards, the nectar of the economy, only flow to identities whose fingerprint stays consistent across epochs. Anyone can forge a fresh identity, but a new one starts with no pigment history, earns nothing until it has produced many peer-checked contributions, and its past work cannot be copied without detection. Forging ten fake agents therefore costs ten separate histories of real, graded work, so sybil scale stops paying.
